meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. Edit the current project requirement and optionally sync all skills into the requirement pool. The right side shows the default team configuration with missing-role prompts and required skill levels. It also includes project progress/outcomes/alerts, product acceptance, editable talent profiles, drag-to-team org chart, one best team with a base team, local SVG summary charts, one-paste feedback, memo, project conversations and capability advice. Local data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
